user.description: Account closing the position; must be the position owner.

note.description: Optional note carried into internal trade logs (opaque to the module).

fraction.description: Fraction of the position to close (0 < fraction <= 1). Provide "1" to close the entire position.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgClosePosit.title: Msg Close Position
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgClosePosit.description: * ClosePosition closes a synthetic leveraged position. Behavior: - Swaps held to the borrowed denom via the borrow vault, computes accrued   interest at the snapshotted rate, restores pool reserves by full   repayment, returns remaining collateral and any profit to the user,   updates pool accounting, and deletes the position. Emits: EventLeveragePositionClosed on success

profit.description: Profit returned to the user (borrowed denom).

collateral_returned.description: Collateral returned to the user (collateral denom).

new_borrowed.description: Borrowed principal remaining on the position after the close.

new_held.description: Held asset remaining on the position after the close.

new_collateral.description: Collateral remaining on the position after the close.

new_collateral_ratio.description: Collateral ratio after the close; "0" when position fully closed.

closed.description: True if the position was fully closed and deleted.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.
